experiments.title: Disable CHARTBOOST
experiments.hypothesis: Removing the zombie frees waterfall slots for higher-eCPM networks; the zombie_network signal clears (network exits the report).
experiments.result_note: predicted signal resolved and user guardrail pending — experiment outcome held

experiments.variant_a: 现状(A)：CHARTBOOST 消耗 17,000 请求仅产生 $0.11（僵尸）
experiments.variant_b: 变体(B)：禁用 → 释放瀑布槽位，请求重新分配到高 eCPM 网络（保守估计 0.5% 重分配转化为收入）
experiments.ab_design: A/B 测量：移除前后同 DAU Revenue/DAU 差分（移除后僵尸信号消失即验证成功）

experiments.title: Increase bid opportunity for MIN_WINNER
experiments.hypothesis: Raising auction exposure captures the network's eCPM-implied potential; the hidden_winner signal should clear without ARPDAU regression.

params.expected_impact: capturing only 15% of its eCPM-implied potential at eCPM $80.00 — raise auction exposure

experiments.result_note: predicted signal resolved and user guardrail pending — experiment outcome held

baseline_user_metrics.note: no user-side key configured (adjust, firebase) — ARPDAU/ads-per-user guardrail pending; connect Adjust or Firebase to enable

experiments.variant_a: 现状(A)：MIN_WINNER 仅捕获其 eCPM 潜力 15% （300 曝光 @ eCPM $80.00，收入占比 8.7%）
experiments.variant_b: 变体(B)：提升 bidding 曝光优先级，目标捕获潜力 → ~58%，预期收入占比 → ~12.4%
experiments.ab_design: A/B 测量：apply 前(A) vs apply 后(B) 同 DAU 下 Revenue/DAU 差分（diff-in-diff vs 账户漂移）

experiments.title: Raise unified auction price floor on APPLOVIN_EXCHANGE to $3.66-$6.86
experiments.hypothesis: Lifting the bid constraint cuts lowest-value backfill; the bid_floor signal should clear with fill-rate guarded.

params.expected_impact: cut lowest-value backfill impressions; watch fill

experiments.variant_b: 变体(B)：设 price floor $3.66–$6.86 过滤低价值填充
